attribution.guard: Three test modules imported ctypes solely as a type annotation. The unchanged refusal guard rejected those imports. The corrected tests use the actual domain slot, which encapsulates the native cell in ops.testing.pidfd_spawn.
attribution.listener: A fabricated Popen PID has no kernel process for the supervisor to pin. The corrected fixture substitutes only the workload: the real supervisor pins and reaps a private, pipe-blocked child inheriting the listener.
